extracted.intended_audience: interested persons, customers and stakeholders of the Southeastern Power Administration (utilities, preference customers, and members of the public who may comment on proposed power rates)
extracted.subtask_description: Federal Register notice setting forth a proposed 5-year rate adjustment for the Cumberland System of Projects, the exact proposed rates by customer class, procedural dates and instructions for public review, attendance at a public information and comment forum, and how to submit written comments and examine supporting studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written comments deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Written comments are due on or before August 13, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Southeastern will evaluate all comments received in this process.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to submit written comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Written comments should be submitted to: Administrator, Southeastern Power Administration, Department of Energy, 1166 Athens Tech Road, Elberton, Georgia 30635-6711; Email: Comments@sepa.doe.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments may be mailed or emailed to the addresses given; the agency will evaluate all comments received.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public information and comment forum scheduling and access
rubrics_metrics.description: A public information and comment forum will be held in-person at Southeastern Power Administration, 1166 Athens Tech Road, Elberton, Georgia at 1 p.m. EDT on June 17, 2025, with an option to attend virtually via Microsoft Teams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The URL and call-in information for the forum are provided (https://bit.ly/​CumberlandbRatebForum2025; +1 (404) 796-9216, Access Code: 425290255#). Persons desiring to attend the forum should notify Southeastern by June 16, 2025, so a list of forum participants can be prepared.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public forum participation and speaking rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Persons desiring to speak at the forum should specify this in their notification to Southeastern; others may speak if time permits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notifications to attend or speak should be submitted by email to Comments@sepa.doe.gov. If Southeastern has not been notified by close of business on June 16, 2025, that at least one person intends to be present (in-person or virtually), the forum may be canceled with no further notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed annual revenue requirement and percent increase
rubrics_metrics.description: The revised repayment study demonstrates an annual revenue requirement of $81,750,000 per year, an increase of $15,600,000 per year (23.58 percent) over the previous annual revenue requirement of $66,150,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Existing rate schedules were predicated on a March 2020 repayment study; the March 2025 study indicates rates are not adequate to recover cost increases and therefore do not meet repayment criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed rates — Inside TVA Preference Customers (capacity, energy, transmission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Capacity and Base Energy: $4.484 per kW/Month. Additional Energy: 17.088 mills per kWh. Transmission: Pass-through.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the proposed schedule values for inside TVA preference customers under the Cumberland System rate proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed rates — Outside TVA Preference Customers (excluding customers served through DEP or EKPC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Capacity and Base Energy: $4.484 per kW/Month. Additional Energy: 17.088 mills per kWh. Transmission: Monthly TVA Transmission Charge divided by 545,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transmission charge for these customers is computed by dividing the Monthly TVA Transmission Charge by 545,000.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed rates — Customers Served Through Duke Energy Progress (DEP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Capacity and Base Energy: $5.076 per kW/Month. TVA Transmission: TVA rate at border as computed above, adjusted for DEP delivery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DEP-served customers have a higher capacity/base energy rate and an adjusted TVA transmission computation for delivery through DEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed rates — East Kentucky Power Cooperative (EKPC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Capacity: $2.348 per kW/Month. Energy: 17.088 mills per kWh. Transmission: Monthly TVA Transmission Charge divided by 545,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EKPC-specific capacity and energy rates are listed separately from other outside-TVA customers.

rubrics_metrics.name: True-up adjustment method and annual schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed rate schedules would continue adjustments annually on April 1, based on transfers of specific power investment to plant-in-service for the preceding Fiscal Year. The annual adjustment will be, for each increase of $1,000,000 to specific power plant-in-service, an increase of $0.003 per kilowatt per month to the base capacity rate and an increase of 0.013 mills per kilowatt-hour to the base additional energy rate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Southeastern will give written notice to customers of the amount of the true-up by February 1 of each year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of referenced repayment studies and proposed rate schedules for inspection
rubrics_metrics.description: The referenced repayment studies are available for examination at 1166 Athens Tech Road, Elberton, Georgia 30635-6711. The Proposed Rate Schedules (CBR-1-K, CSI-1-K, CEK-1-K, CM-1-K, CC-1-L, CK-1-K, CTV-1-K, CTVI-1-D, and Replacement-3) are also available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interested persons may examine the supporting repayment studies and proposed schedules at the stated address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal authority and delegation for rate development and approval
rubrics_metrics.description: By Delegation Order No. S1-DEL-RATES-2016 (effective Nov. 19, 2016) the Secretary delegated authority to develop power and transmission rates to Southeastern's Administrator and other specified authorities. By Delegation Order No. S1-DEL-S3-2024 (effective Aug. 30, 2024) confirmation/approval on an interim basis was delegated to the Under Secretary for Infrastructure. By Redelegation Order No. S3-DEL-SEPA-2023 (effective Apr. 10, 2023) the Under Secretary redelegated the interim authority to the Administrator, Southeastern.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These delegation and redelegation orders constitute the legal basis for Southeastern's rate-development and interim approval actions; final confirmation/approval or remand/disapproval authority rests with FERC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental compliance determination
rubrics_metrics.description: Southeastern is in the process of determining whether an environmental assessment or an environmental impact statement should be prepared or if this action can be categorically excluded from those requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No final determination is presented in the notice; environmental documentation will follow as required under applicable NEPA procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior FERC confirmation and approval reference
rubrics_metrics.description: FERC confirmed and approved on a final basis Wholesale Power Rate Schedules CBR-1-J, CSI-1-J, CEK-1-J, CM-1-J, CC-1-K, CK-1-J, CTV-1-J, CTVI-1-C, and Replacement-3 applicable to Cumberland System of Projects' power for a period ending September 30, 2025 (FERC Docket No. EF20-6-000 (Nov. 5, 2020)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice uses prior FERC-confirmed schedules and their expiration as context for proposing new schedules to be effective October 1, 2025 through September 30, 2030.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency statement of evaluation of comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Southeastern will evaluate all comments received in this process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This statement indicates that comments submitted by the deadline and according to instructions will be considered as part of the agency's decision-making process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official publication and signature/authentication procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: This document was signed May 12, 2025 by Virgil G. Hobbs III, Administrator for Southeastern Power Administration, pursuant to delegated authority; the original signature and date are maintained by DOE, and an authorized DOE Federal Register Liaison Officer submitted the document in electronic format for publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The administrative process of electronic submission does not alter the legal effect of the document upon publication in the Federal Register.
